snippet.title: THE VOICE PARTY : MIMIC GAME TRAILER
snippet.description:
Mimic sounds and compete with friends in a funny multiplayer voice party game.

This multiplayer mimic party game brings friends together for hilarious sound imitation challenges. For fans of charades and group games, it's a fun way to break the ice at parties and game nights.

Sound imitation: Listen to a sound and mimic it with your voice.

Voice impressions: Take turns, pass the phone around and laugh together at everyone's impressions. Earn points, compare scores and crown your party champion. Challenge the winner to a rematch and keep the party going!

Voice party game: Quick rounds and easy rules make it simple for the whole group to play together.

Voice mimic game: Practice solo, then gather your friends for more party games.
